finding.text: The ask says production should show the pictures (thumbs deploy with the site). The diff admits they do not (`doc/next.md` "Not deployed yet"), because `thumbs/` is git-ignored and a Cloudflare build uploads a checkout. That is honest, but the owner's goal is only met locally, so a follow-up on how to ship them should be queued.

The ask names `ext/Shots` / `Server/shots.mjs`, but `Server/CatalogThumbs.mjs:~56` drives the shared `Server/browser.mjs` directly. The reason is stated in the header comment (Shots.run writes a round folder and a runs.jsonl line per shot) and it does not build a second browser launcher, so this is acceptable. The deviation should be logged as a `decision` line.

The ask lists "(+ test)" under the fence, and the diff has no test file for `CatalogThumbs`. The `slug` function is duplicated in `CatalogThumbs.mjs` and `CatalogPage.js` ("must agree"), so a tiny test asserting the two agree would be cheap.

`CatalogPage.js` `watch_hover`: the click handler treats any non-mouse `pointerType` as a first tap. A keyboard Enter on the card link has `pointerType ""`, so the first keypress is swallowed and only boots the iframe. Treat `e.detail === 0` (keyboard) as a normal follow.

`CatalogPage.js` `watch_hover`: the hover iframe is appended over the picture and is blank white until it loads, so there is a flash on every hover. Fading it in on its `load` event, or keeping the picture visible until then, would be gentler.

`CatalogThumbs.status` judges freshness by file mtime. A fresh git checkout or pull resets mtimes, so a later `--apply` may reshoot everything (about 30 min). That is fine for a local tool, but `readme.md` could mention `--only` for partial refreshes.

The before/after numbers are in `doc/next.md` (49 cards: 1st/10th/20th/40th at 0.74 s with pictures vs 1.25/5.2/11.5 s and "not in 14 s" with iframes). That meets the under-2-s target, but no shots are linked in the new section even though the ask says "with the shots".
